description_en: Creates a renewal order for a subscription ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 为包年包月的云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例续费
name: RenewInstance

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] You cannot change the storage capacity when you renew an instance. By default, the renewal order is placed based on the current specifications
parameters.help_zh: 续费不允许变更存储容量，该参数已经弃用，默认按当前规格下订单续费
parameters.name: capacity

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] You cannot change the instance type when you renew an instance. By default, the renewal order is placed based on the current specifications
parameters.help_zh: 续费不允许变更规格，该参数已经弃用，默认按当前规格下订单续费
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en:
The renewal period. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.
For example, if an instance expires in 3 months and you renew it for 3 months, the instance will expire in 6 months after the renewal
parameters.help_zh:
续费的周期，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36。
例如实例还有3个月到期，本次续费3个月，则本次续费后，实例还剩余6个月到期
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. This is the default value.
false: disables automatic payment.

<props="china">If you set this parameter to false, you must log on to the console, choose Billing > Renewal Management in the top navigation bar, and then choose Order Management > My Orders in the left-side navigation pane to find and pay for the order.</props>

<props="intl">If you set this parameter to false, you must log on to the console, choose Billing > Renewal Management in the top navigation bar, and then click Order Management in the left-side navigation pane to find and pay for the order.</props>



<props="partner">If you set this parameter to false, you must log on to the console, choose Billing > Renewal Management in the top navigation bar, and then click Order Management in the left-side navigation pane to find and pay for the order.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：

true：自动付费，默认值。
false：手动付费。

<props="china">选择为手动付费时，您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理 > 我的订单，找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

<props="intl">选择为手动付费时，您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理，找到目标订单进行支付。</props>



<props="partner">选择为手动付费时，您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理，找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The source of the request. Default value: OpenAPI. You do not need to manually specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用于备注请求来源，默认值为OpenAPI，无需手动设置
parameters.name: from_app

parameters.help_en: The activity ID and business information
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal. The instance is renewed for the specified period. For example, if you set the renewal period to 3 months, the instance is automatically renewed for 3 months each time.
false: disables auto-renewal. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启，按以选择的续费时长进行续费，例如您选择续费时长为3个月，那么每次自动续费时会缴纳3个月的费用。
false（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the order. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
EndTime.description_zh:
订单结束时间。

格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间
